fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.name: Mood Cairns
fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.summary: Private, fully offline mood tracker with tags and charts. No network access.
fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.description:
A private, fully offline Android mood tracker. Log how you're feeling against your own Scales, with your own Tags, in your own time windows, on your own device. Nothing is ever uploaded - backup, if you want it, is done your own way (hint: Syncthing works well on the encrypted backups you save.).
 Features 
* Custom Scales. Five built-in scales (Happiness, Anxiety, Stress, Boredom, Pain), each numeric and color-tagged. Add your own; archive the ones you don't want.
* Custom Tags. Choose from many built-in Tags for Places, People, Activities, Moods, etc. or add your own to customize your tracking!
* Prompt windows. Define time-of-day windows (e.g. morning 08:00-12:00, evening 18:00-20:00). The app fires one notification per window per day. Tap the notification to jump straight to the log entry screen.
* History and charts. Browse past entries, see per-scale trends over time.
* In your language. Available in English, Spanish, and German. Choose the app language in Settings, independent of your phone's language.
* Encrypted on-disk storage. The mood database is encrypted at rest using SQLCipher. The key lives in memory only while the app is unlocked, and is wiped when you lock it.
* PIN + biometric lock. PIN-gated app entry, with optional biometric unlock. PIN is hashed with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) before being stored.
* Encrypted backups. Manual export writes an AES-GCM-encrypted JSON file to Documents/MoodCairns/. The encryption key is derived from a backup passphrase you choose (minimum 8 characters) with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) and a fresh per-backup salt embedded in the envelope, so any install (including a fresh one) can decrypt with the same passphrase. Backups from older versions, which were encrypted with the app PIN, still import with that PIN.
 Privacy contract 
The app declares no network permissions . Without internet, the process literally cannot open a socket, which makes phone-home impossible regardless of what any included library tries to do.
The build enforces this, so a network permission can never be silently introduced by a dependency update.
If you want backups synced off-device, point Syncthing (or any file manager that can sync a folder) at Documents/MoodCairns/.
 Contact 
The best way to get in touch for issues, feature requests, etc. is the Issues page on github.com/lcdcode/mood-cairns. I will usually respond within 3 business days. 
 Source 
Fully open source under GPL-3.0-only. Built on Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, SQLCipher, and AndroidX.

fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.name: MX3 Button Mapper
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.summary: Remap MX3 Air Mouse remote buttons on Google TV
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.description:
MX3 Button Mapper remaps hardware buttons on MX3-style air-mouse remotes connected to Google TV devices -- buttons that send the wrong keycode, or nothing useful at all, out of the box.
 It works by combining two Android mechanisms:
 • An Accessibility Service that listens for raw scancodes system-wide and can consume (swallow) the original button press.
 • Shizuku, used to inject a replacement keycode or press sequence in place of the original one. Shizuku grants this using the same shell-level privileges 'adb shell input keyevent' already has, so no root is required. If Shizuku isn't connected but the device is rooted, the app falls back to injecting keys via 'su' instead, and so will ask your root manager for superuser access.
 Supported mapping types (a ready-made default mapping set is built in, so there is nothing to configure per button):
 • Remap a button to a different keycode (e.g. a stray Page Up/Page Down button remapped to proper Channel Up/Channel Down).
 • Fire the same keycode several times in one press (e.g. a single button that sends five D-pad presses to jump through a list).
 • Remap a button differently depending on which app is in the foreground (e.g. Channel Up/Down inside the TV app, a single Page Up/Page Down inside Kodi, and a burst of D-pad presses to jump through lists everywhere else).
 • Launch an app directly from a button press, while holding the same button still sends its normal long-press (e.g. tapping Home opens MX3 Launcher, holding it long-presses Home).
 In-app settings:
 • TV brand (TCL or Blaupunkt), since these TVs expect different keycodes for the remote's TV button and use different live-TV apps.
 • Optional key-press logging for troubleshooting, off by default.
 • App language, with the interface translated into around 100 languages.
 The app also sets itself up via Shizuku: once you agree to the in-app disclosure, it enables its own Accessibility Service for you, so there is no need to dig through Settings -> Accessibility by hand, it can launch your chosen launcher on startup, and on TCL TVs it re-grants the auto-start permission that TCL's firmware otherwise removes, so the mapper keeps working after a reboot.
 Note: some of the default mappings launch specific third-party apps for convenience (e.g. jumping straight to a launcher, a video app or a browser).
 Accessibility Service API use:
 This app uses the Accessibility Service API for its core function. The service:
 • Receives hardware key events from your remote so it can replace specific buttons with a different key, a burst of key presses, or an app launch. Buttons that aren't mapped pass through untouched.
 • Receives window-change events only to learn the package name of the app on screen, so a button can behave differently inside the TV app.
 It does not read screen content, text or passwords. No key presses or other data are collected, stored (unless you turn on the optional troubleshooting logs, which stay on the device) or shared -- the app has no internet access. The service is only turned on after you agree to an in-app disclosure, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings -> Accessibility.

fdroid:com.xprs.app.name: XPRS
fdroid:com.xprs.app.summary: Off-grid messenger over the internet, Reticulum and a Bluetooth mesh
fdroid:com.xprs.app.description:
XPRS is a messenger and app launcher that works off the grid. It talks over the internet, over a Reticulum overlay, and straight over Bluetooth LE, and it stitches those together so a message or a file gets to the other side over whatever path happens to be up. If there is no internet, it falls back to a Bluetooth street mesh and long range radio. If there is internet, it uses it.
There are no accounts, no phone number and no server in the middle. Your identity is a key the device makes itself.
 What it does 
 Many transports at once. A message can go out over the internet, over Bluetooth LE, or over Reticulum, and whichever copy arrives first wins.
 It keeps working with no internet. A Bluetooth street mesh passes messages from phone to phone with nothing in between, and cheap LoRa stations push that reach out over kilometres.
 Store and forward. A message for somebody who is away is carried by the stations in between and delivered when they come back.
 Chat. One-to-one conversations, closed groups and a local room, with pictures and files.
 Social. Posts, replies and follows, spread over the same transports.
 Torrents and shared folders. Files move peer to peer, from whoever has them.
 Wapps. Small WebAssembly apps that draw through one shared native interface and use the host's transports: chat, social, mail, a media player, a file browser and more. You can install others, or write your own in the built-in editor.
 Network use 
A fresh install connects to a few public Reticulum hubs, which you can change or switch off in Settings. Maps (OpenStreetMap), torrents, and pictures you send to somebody on another network reach the internet only when you use them. NOSTR and I2P are off unless you turn them on.
XPRS is free software under the BSD 3-Clause licence.

Mage is an Android GUI for age file encryption, built on kage (a Kotlin/JVM implementation of the age protocol). "Mage" is short for Mobile age. Mage is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the age project.
Encrypt or decrypt files to age recipients or passphrases, including armor, multi-recipient, and encrypt-to-self. SSH keys (ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa) work as recipients and identities alongside native age keys, and can be mixed on one file.
Identities are sealed in the Android Keystore (AES-256-GCM, StrongBox where available) behind biometric or device-credential authentication. Recipients get a small address book with QR encode/scan for sharing a public key.
Batch mode encrypts or decrypts more than one file at a time into a folder. Your identity vault can be exported and re-imported as an encrypted backup, so it isn't stuck on one device.
Mage hooks into the system where it makes sense: share-sheet targets, a .age file-manager association, launcher shortcuts, and a Quick Settings tile.
Mage does not implement its own cryptography — that is kage's job. It is not a general-purpose file manager or password manager, and it does not support the age-plugin mechanism, which relies on binaries on $PATH and does not work on Android.
Mage requests no network permission and makes no network connections.

apple-macos:6781590712.name: FlatNote
apple-macos:6781590712.description:
FlatNote is a markdown notes app for people who want their writing to stay plain, portable, and theirs. It runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and your notes sync across all of them through your own iCloud, or stay in a folder you choose.
Type markdown and watch it format as you go. Headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, quotes, bullet lists, and tappable checkboxes all render while you write. The raw symbols stay out of your way and reappear only on the line you are editing, so you always know exactly what you typed.
WHAT YOU GET
- Live formatting. See the result as you type, with a one minute reference note included.
- Photos in your notes. Paste an image or attach one; it is saved next to the note as an ordinary file, not in a database.
- Folders, pins, and sorting. Organize notes into real directories and keep the ones you use on top.
- Real checkboxes. Tap to check things off, right in the note.
- Find in a note. Search the open note and jump between highlighted matches.
- Quick formatting. A formatting bar above the keyboard on iPhone and iPad, and standard shortcuts on Mac.
- Find your notes fast. Search the whole library by title or content.
YOUR WORDS BELONG TO YOU
- Every note is a plain .md file. No proprietary format, no lock-in, readable in any app, on any device, years from now.
- Your notes live in your iCloud and sync across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac automatically, signed in with your Apple ID. No separate account to make.
- Export carries everything. Share any note as markdown, with its pictures included, or export your whole library as one zip of ordinary files. The files are also right there in the Files app on iOS and Finder on Mac.
- Delete is honest. Deleted notes go to Trash, where they can be recovered.
QUIET BY DESIGN
- No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Nothing about you leaves your devices and your iCloud.
- Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, in light and dark.
FlatNote keeps the format simple so you can keep your thinking clear.

The Heatmap view shows you the most-used keys in each of your layers, as you work. This helps you develop awareness, avoid straining weaker fingers, and fine-tune your layout over time so that it uses your strongest fingers for maximum comfort.
Keymapp's window can be made small, and can be kept always-on-top so you can use it as an overlay in the corner of your screen. Alternatively, it can work as a regular window and be as large as you want it.

apple-macos:6753737815.name: Plate Pro: Food Cost & Recipes
apple-macos:6753737815.description:
Know your true plate cost, on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Plate Pro is the native Apple app for food costing. Change one supplier price and every recipe, sub-recipe and menu re-costs itself, instantly. No spreadsheets to maintain. No browser tab to babysit. No account required.
THE COST CASCADE
Ingredients feed your recipes. Recipes feed your menus. When an ingredient price changes, Plate Pro flows that change through everything it touches, so your food cost % and gross profit are always live and accurate. It is the one job a spreadsheet never gets right.
MENU ENGINEERING
See every dish plotted by popularity and profit: Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles and Dogs, so you know what to promote, reprice or cut. Build menus from your recipes and watch the margin update live.
WORK WITH AN AI ASSISTANT
Connect Claude to Plate Pro on your Mac and ask about your numbers in plain language. The built-in assistant can read your suppliers, ingredients, recipes, costs, events, to-dos, notes and waste reports, and create or edit them for you, over a private local connection. Great for processing invoices and updating supplier prices automatically. (macOS)
BUILT FOR THE MAC, AND YOUR POCKET
A real desktop app for back-office work: fast, full-screen, keyboard-quick. Plus iPhone and iPad for costing on the line or at the supplier. Everything syncs over iCloud, and it all works offline.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Cost recipes and nested sub-recipes with a live cost cascade
• Engineer your menus by popularity and profit
• Track supplier prices with full history and % change
• See food cost %, gross profit and suggested price on every recipe
• Log wastage with reasons and cost
• Keep ingredient reference data: units, conversions, allergens and par levels
• Plan ahead with a built-in planner, to-dos and notes
• Import ingredient prices by CSV
• Print recipe books, plating sheets and forms
• Run multiple businesses from one app
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No tracking. The developer collects no data. Your recipes and numbers stay on your device and in your private iCloud. The AI assistant is optional and runs over a local connection you control.
START FREE, OR SUBSCRIBE
Start free and cost your first recipes, with no trial clock. Unlock unlimited ingredients, recipes and suppliers, plus multi-business and recipe cost history, with a subscription. Or buy Plate Pro once and own it for life.
Built by hospitality people. Available in 30 languages (new translations, machine-assisted and still being refined; tell us via support if a phrase reads oddly).
Know your plate cost. Protect your margin. Get Plate Pro.

fedora-packages:tre/agrep.name: agrep

fedora-packages:bsf/bsf.name: bsf
fedora-packages:bsf/bsf.description: Bean Scripting Framework (BSF) is a set of Java classes which provides scripting language support within Java applications, and access to Java objects and methods from scripting languages. BSF allows one to write JSPs in languages other than Java while providing access to the Java class library. In addition, BSF permits any Java application to be implemented in part (or dynamically extended) by a language that is embedded within it. This is achieved by providing an API that permits calling scripting language engines from within Java, as well as an object registry that exposes Java objects to these scripting language engines. BSF supports several scripting languages currently: * Javascript (using Rhino ECMAScript, from the Mozilla project) * Python (using either Jython or JPython) * Tcl (using Jacl) * NetRexx (an extension of the IBM REXX scripting language in Java) * XSLT Stylesheets (as a component of Apache XML project's Xalan and Xerces) In addition, the following languages are supported with their own BSF engines: * Java (using BeanShell, from the BeanShell project) * JRuby * JudoScript

firefox-addons:2965364.name: QSS eID
firefox-addons:2965364.summary: Use your electronic identification card for secure authentication and digital signing.
firefox-addons:2965364.description:
Use your electronic identification card for secure authentication and digital signing.
QSS eID is an eIDAS-compliant web signing extension that connects your electronic identification card to your web browser, enabling secure authentication and legally binding digital signatures on supported websites.
It supports certified electronic identity and digital certificate issuers in Bosnia and Herzegovina and across the European Union, without vendor lock-in.
What it does
• Securely authenticates users to government portals, banks, and online services using an electronic ID card
• Digitally signs documents and transactions using an electronic signature
• Works with websites that support eID-based authentication
Why install it
• No passwords – your ID card is your credential
• Legally valid digital signatures recognized across the EU
• Secure communication between your browser and smart card reader
Digital Sovereignty & Compliance
• Private keys never leave the user’s electronic ID card or secure device
• No certificates, identities, or credentials are stored or managed by QSS eID
• QSS eID does not act as a certificate authority or identity provider
• Identity management remains with certified trust service providers
Designed for compliance with eIDAS, national digital identity frameworks, and cross-border EU interoperability.
Privacy
• No personal data is collected, stored, or tracked
• No analytics, telemetry, or user activity monitoring
• No access to PINs or private cryptographic material
• All cryptographic operations are performed locally on the user’s device
Fully aligned with GDPR requirements.
Requirements
• A supported electronic ID card or qualified digital certificate
• A compatible smart card reader
• The QSS eID native application installed on your computer

firefox-addons:2981878.name: DevScope - Developer Diagnostics
firefox-addons:2981878.summary: Inspect DOM, CSS, performance, security, accessibility, SEO, network and storage in one dockable developer panel.
firefox-addons:2981878.description:
DevScope is a professional browser development toolkit for on-demand inspection and diagnostics of the active webpage.
Analyze page structure, CSS, performance, network activity, security headers, accessibility, SEO, storage, runtime behavior, and detected frameworks without switching between scattered tools.
 🧩 DOM AND ELEMENT INSPECTION 
• Analyze DOM depth, complexity, duplicate IDs, detached nodes, inline styles, and semantic structure
• Select elements directly on the page with highlight overlays and breadcrumb navigation
• Review actionable hints for common structural anti-patterns
 🎨 CSS INSPECTION AND LIVE EDITING 
• View computed styles, box model details, and the properties that actually apply
• Detect specificity conflicts and possible layout issues
• Edit styles live, see changes immediately, and reset individual properties
 ⚡ PERFORMANCE AND CORE WEB VITALS 
• Review Core Web Vitals, paint timing, resource timing, and long tasks
• Inspect JavaScript execution signals and resource usage by type
• Identify slow assets and likely performance bottlenecks
 🌐 NETWORK, STORAGE AND RUNTIME 
• Group network requests by type and status and inspect timing details
• Review LocalStorage, SessionStorage, cookies, IndexedDB, and Cache API data
• Inspect runtime errors, console messages, event listeners, timers, and script activity
 🔐 SECURITY AND ACCESSIBILITY 
• Validate HTTPS, mixed content, CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy, and X-Frame-Options
• Run WCAG-oriented checks for ARIA, contrast, landmarks, labels, and missing alternative text
• Use clear findings and recommendations to prioritize fixes
 🔎 SEO AND FRAMEWORK DETECTION 
• Check meta tags, Open Graph, canonical URLs, structured data, heading hierarchy, and indexability
• Detect React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, jQuery, Next.js, Nuxt.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and other libraries
• Review available version information and possible outdated dependencies
 🏥 SITE HEALTH REPORT 
• Generate prioritized findings grouped as P0, P1, and P2
• Use the DX Score from 0 to 100 as a quick technical health indicator
• Review stability, network, performance, and DOM-quality signals in one report
 📊 EXPORT AND COMPARE 
• Export reports in JSON, CSV, or Markdown
• Create snapshots and compare results to identify regressions
• Export individual modules for focused review
 🛠 BUILT FOR REAL DEBUGGING 
Dock the panel on the right or bottom, use floating mode, resize it, and toggle it with Ctrl+Shift+D.
Shadow DOM isolation helps reduce interference with inspected pages. Dark and light themes are available, with system synchronization where supported. The interface is available in 15 languages.
 🔒 PRIVACY FIRST 
The extension does not collect personal data, track browsing activity, run analytics or telemetry, or contact external servers.
Page analysis runs locally on the device. Preferences are stored in the browser and remain on the machine.
 🏢 ABOUT THE AUTHOR 
DevScope is developed by POLPROG, a Polish technology company creating browser extensions, web applications, and mobile apps with a focus on privacy.
Website: https://polprog.pl/

apple-macos:6761332019.description:
Ideas do not win on merit alone. They win when they are understood, trusted, remembered, and acted on.
Persuasion helps people communicate with more clarity, confidence, and impact.
Whether the goal is to pitch an idea, grow a business, perform better in sales, lead a team, prepare for an interview, negotiate more effectively, or simply become more convincing in everyday life, Persuasion teaches the principles that help messages land.
Built around timeless influence principles and modern behavioral insight, Persuasion turns the psychology of persuasion into practical skill.
Inside the app, learners can explore how influence really works, why people say yes, why they resist, how trust is built, and how stronger communication creates better outcomes in work and life.
WITH PERSUASION, USERS CAN:
• Learn core principles of influence in a clear, engaging format
• Build stronger instincts for communication, trust, credibility, and buy-in
• Understand concepts like authority, social proof, reciprocity, scarcity, framing, and more
• Apply persuasive thinking to sales, leadership, marketing, negotiation, interviews, presentations, and everyday conversations
• Strengthen confidence in high-stakes moments where words matter most
DESIGNED FOR:
• Sales professionals
• Founders and entrepreneurs
• Marketers and creators
• Managers and leaders
• Job seekers and professionals
• Students
• Anyone who wants to communicate more effectively
Persuasion is not about manipulation. It is about understanding human behavior, presenting ideas more clearly, and creating genuine influence in an ethical, practical way.
For anyone who wants to become more compelling, more strategic, and more effective when it matters, Persuasion is a smarter way to learn the art and psychology of influence.

apple-macos:6763833379.name: WindTrac: Marine Weather Map
apple-macos:6763833379.description:
WindTrac shows the wind the way it actually moves, and with WindTrac Pro it keeps working when the signal is gone. Download the forecast for where you're heading and the live, animated map of wind, waves and weather goes with you: offshore, into the mountains or onto a plane.
Instead of a grid of arrows or a table of numbers, tens of thousands of particles flow with the forecast wind, speed as colour, direction as motion. The gust front, the light-air hole and the wind bending around a headland are obvious at a glance.
Built for kitesurfers, windsurfers and wing foilers, sailors and boaters, surfers, paraglider pilots and anglers. Anyone who plans the day around the wind and the water.
What makes it different
A forecast that works offline. Most weather apps go blank without a connection. With WindTrac Pro, pick an area and the layers you need, and every forecast hour comes with you, along with the timeline, the animation and the map itself. Keep several areas saved.
Eight forecast models in one app. Switch between NOAA GFS, the NOAA GEFS ensemble mean, DWD ICON and the high-resolution ICON-EU, ECMWF IFS HRES and the ECMWF AIFS AI model, plus two wave models. When the models disagree, you see it straight away.
Numbers where they matter. The strongest gusts, the calmest patches, the biggest waves and the warmest and coldest spots are labelled on the map automatically.
Read the wind
Tap anywhere for the exact speed in knots, km/h, mph or m/s, or switch to gusts to see what you will really be reefing, depowering or scrubbing a launch for. The altitude slider runs from 10 m up through 850, 700, 500 and 250 hPa, from a paraglider launch to the jet stream.
Read the sea
Significant wave height and direction, animated so you can watch a swell roll towards your beach, plus peak and mean wave period to tell a short, choppy wind sea from a long-period groundswell before you load the car. Heights in metres or feet.
Plan the session, the passage or the flight
Drag the timeline to any time in the forecast, or press play and watch a weather system cross the map in seconds. Rain, snow, low cloud and temperature (°C or °F) are a tap away. Save favourite spots and show times in your zone, the spot's or UTC.
Storm Watch
In the US and Canada, official watches and warnings from the National Weather Service and Environment Canada are drawn on the map. Tap one for the full text. Follow hurricanes with the National Hurricane Center's forecast cone, track and 34-knot wind field, which moves with the timeline so you can see when tropical-storm-force wind could arrive. All of it can be switched off.
